title: The work page
description: Chat on the left, your site on the right, and Publish and Console in the header.
sidebar:
  order: 2
---

Every agent has a work page, and the work page is where you spend your time: you talk to the builder on the left and see the site on the right. It opens as soon as you start an agent, and you can come back to it from **My agents** or from **RECENT AGENTS** in the left rail.

![The work page of The Cozy Coffee Table: the builder's reply on the left, and the live preview of the site on the right.](/images/build/work-page-1.webp)

1. The header. From left to right: **My agents / The Cozy Coffee Table** (click **My agents** to go back to the list), the App switcher, **Publish** and **Console**. An agent can hold more than one App. The App switcher chooses which App the right side shows, and which one **Code**, **Domains** and **Environment** in the Console act on. The left rail shrinks to icons on this page.
2. The chat, on the left. It holds your messages and the builder's replies, one step per line, with a status line under each reply. At the bottom is the box you type in. **+** attaches a file, and the chip, for example **Auto · Build**, picks the model and the mode. The send arrow turns into a red stop button while the builder works.
3. The App view, on the right. The tabs **Preview** and **Data** show the App you picked in the header. **Contract** appears only for an App that has a smart contract. The Preview toolbar has a reload button, a page picker (**Home**, **Menu**, **Book a table**), a device picker, a pencil for **Edit mode**, and **Open** to view the site in its own tab.
4. The Console. Click **Console** in the header to open it over the App view, and click ✕ to close it. Its sections are listed below.

## What is in the Console

- **Overview**: the agent's name and product, who can open it, your role, whether it is published, and its Apps.
- **Build**: the tasks, plan and Apps of a build that follows an approved plan. It shows up when the agent has such a build. See [Watch it build](/agent/watch-build/).
- **Code**: the App's files, read only. See [Browse the code](/build/code/).
- **Files**: optional PDF, PowerPoint and Word files that you give the builder as reference.
- **Memory**: what the agent has recorded, including the decisions you made.
- **Sessions**: what the Apps contain, and where the owner can **Start a new session**.
- **Plugins**: the built-in capabilities of the agent's product.
- **Domains**: the App's web address and your own domain. See [Domains](/build/domains/).
- **Production**: what is live, its versions, and **Unpublish**. See [Go live](/build/go-live/).
- **Scheduled tasks**: jobs your App runs at set times. See [What your site can do](/build/what-your-site-can-do/).
- **Environment**: values your App reads, kept apart for development and live. See [Environment values](/build/environment-values/).
- **Learners**: the people who joined, for agents that have learners or a course.
- **Settings**: the agent's name, access, collaborators, ownership and deletion. See [Manage your agents](/agent/manage-agents/).

## Good to know

- **Publish** is greyed out while the builder is working, and before there is anything to publish.
- What you can do depends on your role. The owner can do everything, including **Publish**, the live **Environment** values and **Domains**. Editors can chat and build. Viewers can only look. See [Work with others](/agent/work-with-others/).
